text: Kit fonts first. When the run has a brand kit, its declared families are the brand voice — the library never replaces them for text the kit already covers. Reach for the library when the kit lacks a face for a role and brand adherence allows a neighbor.
note: No skill or guide links to this file, so the agent only finds it by listing the folder.

text: No-kit runs choose from this list, by tone. Defaulting everything to Inter is a missed decision, not a safe one: pick a voice that matches the brief and say so in your direction notes.
Family table with weights, italics, tone and notes (e.g. Inter "the default voice … never a risk"; Playfair Display "luxury and fashion headlines, never body").
note: Inter is called both "a missed decision" and "the default voice … never a risk".
